notes: Seven own pages read on hawksoft.com, all HTTP 200 and not thin. HawkSoft has no pricing page; the HawkSoft 6 FAQ gives a $99 per user retail price, used to class C01 and C05 true and C03 and C04 wrong. C03 ($130 per user) is traced to the agencymate.com comparison article (read under the EZLynx cause tracing, cited by q4 Claude run 1 and q10 Google AI Overviews run 2). C04 cause not found: deelo.ai and ustechautomations.com do not carry it and the cited Reddit threads are disallowed by robots.txt (not requested). Monthly agency totals and annual figures ($250, $109, $3,000 to $8,000) are unverifiable because the vendor prices per user. C15 (no contract) is read as no long-term contract; C31 (Windows and Mac compatible) is classed true on the FAQ's qualified yes. Not coded: review ratings and satisfaction scores, the opinion transparent pricing, features (no built-in rater, open API, e-signature, phone integration), statements whose subject is another vendor (InsuredMine's integration list), hedged lines, and the q10 Google AI Overviews run 3 comparison table, whose header lists two vendors over three data columns so the HawkSoft contract cell cannot be attributed. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser reads exist for this vendor and no claim was unverifiable because of a blocked or thin page, so nothing was re-classed; the only free trials on the pages read belong to partner products (partners page), so C20 stays unverifiable. Gap lines were price table cells already coded for the same answers (C05, C10), fit opinions, open API and generic partner-integration lines with no named product, or about other vendors; pairing HawkSoft with AgencyZoom (q6 Claude run 2) was read as usage, not an integration statement. Comparison tables with HawkSoft as a column header (q7 ChatGPT runs 1 and 2, q7 Claude runs 1 and 3) carry only facts already coded for those answers. One instance added: q7 AI Mode run 3 (Mac-based agencies run it via hosted environments like Parallels) to C31. Consistency check: C03 and C04 stay wrong; the FAQ answers a monthly-bill question with a $99 per user retail price for HawkSoft 6, the only edition sold to new customers, so both figures are per user per month against per user per month and the contradiction is explicit.
